profile.headline: Solutions Architect/Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
•	 Full SDLC expertise across Internet, Intranet, N-Tier, and Client/Server applications.
•	 AI & Agentic Development: Designed and implemented MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers integrated with Azure DevOps, enabling AI agents (GitHub Copilot, Kiro IDE, and custom agents) to interact with live project data, repositories, pipelines, and observability tools. Built specialized agents for automated PR review, code quality, performance analysis, pre-commit validation, and log analysis using RAG and LLM integration.
•	Proficient in cloud platforms: AWS (Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SES, Cognito, EC2, API Gateway) and Azure (Azure functions, App Service, SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Data Factory).
•	Strong frontend skills: React, Redux, React-three-fiber, AngularJS/Angular 2–18, Vue.js, Knockout.js, Three.js, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform).
•	Backend expertise: Python (FastAPI), Node.js, ASP.NET (MVC, Web API, Blazor), C# .NET 8-10, VB.NET, ADO.NET.
•	Database: MS SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, XSD/XML/XSLT/XPath, LINQ, Stored Procs, Triggers, Views, PyMySQL, SQLite. 
•	Web services & APIs: RESTful APIs, WCF, AJAX, Event-driven architecture.
•	DevOps & tools: Kubernetes, Docker, TFS, Visual Studio, Karma, Postman, Swagger.
•	UI/UX: Bootstrap, Material UI, Xamarin, WinForms, WebForms, Expression Blend.
•	Advanced .NET features: Reflection, Delegates, Enterprise Library, Custom Controls.
